verdict.rationale: Org-wide policy enforcement is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions admin consoles, org policies, enforced app lock, export restrictions or master-credential requirements. The export docs describe user-initiated export options rather than admin restrictions on export, and vault sharing is an adjacent feature, not policy enforcement.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
